legenda: O que você faria se o seu próprio reflexo tentasse te puxar para o fundo? 🌊 Conte aqui nos comentários se você teria coragem de encarar essas águas. #terror #suspense #historiasdeterror #misterio
falas: I ignored every warning and rowed into the Lake of the Drowned right at midnight.
Beneath the calm dark water, pale hands began tapping softly against my wooden boat.
My flashlight flickered and died, revealing dozens of glowing white eyes staring upward.
A freezing wet arm shot out of the water, wrapping tight around my ankle.
The lake began to boil with trapped souls, all whispering my name in unison.
I managed to break free and reach shore, but my reflection stayed underwater smiling.
If your reflection pulled you into that dark lake, would you fight or surrender?
